newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCKS STEADILY GAIN GROUND, UNIBANKA LEADS.
newsitem.headline: STOCKS STEADILY GAIN GROUND, UNIBANKA LEADS.

text.p: * Total turnover came to 111,000 lats from 93,000 as prices maintained their slow but steady upward movement.
* Rietumu index rose 1.76 percent and reached 190.59.
* Unibanka extended gains, being the biggest riser with another 10 santimes added to 3.40 lats on turnover of 48,400 lats.
* Valmiera Glassfibre led the secondary list in trade of 19,400 lats. It rose to 1.58 lats from 1.55 lats.
Latvian stocks extended their recent modest gains on Monday with the upward trend expected to persist, dealers said.
Total turnover came to 111,000 lats against 93,000 lats and the Rietumu index rose 1.76 percent and reached 190.59.
"The bourse seems to be steady in its slow upward trend and no bigger changes are expected in the near-term," Robert Idelsons, Trasta securities department head, told Reuters.
Unibanka was the biggest gainer with another 10 santimes added to 3.40 lats on turnover of 48,400 lats.
Other blue chips also extended their recent gains and Valmiera Glassfibre led the secondary list in trade of 19,400 lats. It rose to 1.58 lats from 1.55 lats.
"Kaija, RTF, Valmiera, and Manhgali Shipyard keep gaining as investors seem to be taking a more long-term approach," Idelsons said.
Daugavpils Chain, recently a leading stock, which remains stable to lower, is an example of that, Idelsons said.
Daugavpils traded 7,900 lats and it slipped one santime to 2.30 lats.

Elsewhere on the official list, the Riga Shipyard was up one santime to 1.38 lats in 10,100 lats of trade and the Riga Transport Fleet had volume of 7,800 lats as it edged up one santime to 1.31 lats.
Staburadze stayed put at 2.70 lats as it saw 4,100 lats of shares change hands.
Other secondary list stocks were sluggish and some 14 stocks were not quoted on Monday.
